Name: Fishing Trawler Starblue Recolor
Author: GentleRosie
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
A [i]Content Patcher[/i] mod to overrides the default [i]Fishing Trawler[/i] environment sprite to create a more immersive experience.

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]Download the zip-file and drag and drop the file into the Mods folder in the Stardew directory. [/color]

[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
Supports [i]Generic Mod Config Menu[/i], adds a toggle to enable or disable the patch.

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]Make sure [i][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/15941]Fishing Trawler - New Horizons[/url][/i], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915][i]Content Patcher[/i][/url], and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21085][i]Starblue Valley Unofficial[/i][/url] is installed.[/color]

[size=4][b]Shout outs[/b][/size]
Big thanks to [i]Crystalean[/i] for mentioning re-coloring support. Inspired me to make my own.

Manifest.Description: Fishing Trawler enviroment recolor to match Starblue.
